title: Crispy Buffalo Shrimp
description: This baked crispy Buffalo shrimp recipe combines deep-fried shrimp with the flavors of buffalo wings and ranch dipping sauce for a crowd-pleasing appetizer.
ingredients: 0.5 cup all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
30 frozen medium shrimp - thawed, shelled, and deveined
0.25 cup hot pepper sauce (such as Frank's RedHot®), or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Whisk flour, lemon pepper seasoning, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl. Whisk eggs and milk together in a separate bowl.

Pat shrimp dry with paper towels. Dip shrimp in egg mixture, then dredge in flour mixture to evenly coat. Transfer shrimp to a baking sheet in a single layer until ready to fry; sprinkle remaining flour to fully cover as needed.

Carefully lower shrimp, in batches of 8 to 10, into the hot oil; fry until golden brown and cooked through on the inside, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with paper towels. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
Toss shrimp with hot sauce in a large bowl until completely coated.
